what_went_wrong: The overnight counter read one key, "cases", from each sweep's result file. One sweep writes "space" and "evaluated" instead. It ran 47 times, re-verified card against processor every time and recorded 0 differ every time - and was logged as a SUCCESS contributing nothing. That is worse than a failure: a failure is logged and looked at, while this sat in the log as '0 cases' beside a correct 0-differ and no one had to explain it. The arithmetic was never wrong; the bookkeeping was.
how_it_was_found: The per-pass figure was exactly the sum of four of the five sweeps, while the failure count read zero. Those two facts cannot both be innocent.
verification_unaffected: Every run in both figures re-verified the card against the processor before reporting and recorded 0 differ. The correction adds runs that were already proven, it does not relax anything.
anonymised: No project, site, maker or model anywhere.
